evals.expected_output: Recognizes a bare YouTube URL as a request to summarize. Fetches the transcript (Mark Tilbury beginner stock-investing guide) and returns TL;DR + overview + key points grounded in the transcript.

assertions.text: Output contains a TL;DR section or labeled one-to-three-line takeaway near the top
Output contains a bulleted key-points / takeaways section

Output includes at least one specific detail that only appears in the transcript (e.g. the 70/20/10 rule, the ~3.8% inflation figure, S&P 500 / index funds, or specific tickers like VOO/VTI), proving the transcript was actually fetched rather than guessed from the title
Output contains no fabricated facts, figures, or names not supported by the transcript
